title: CodeChallenge: HellaSwag evals in two models (part 1)

cues.en: Earlier in the course, you learned about the attention algorithm and how the three weights matrices are all square, so wq w k and w v.

cues.en: Now it turns out that they are square, not by mathematical necessity, but by convention they do not have to be square.
cues.zh: 其實方陣是慣例，不是數學必要條件。

cues.en: The group that created the Zephyr model, Mistral, uses a slightly alternative way of organizing the
cues.zh: 建立 Zephyr 模型的 Mistral 團隊，使用稍有不同的

cues.en: attention matrices, which was based on an idea that was developed at Google Research.
cues.zh: 注意力矩陣組織方式，依據 Google Research 提出的想法。

cues.en: So here you can see the reference for that paper.
cues.zh: 這裡是論文參考。

cues.en: The technique is called grouped query attention or GQ.
cues.zh: 稱為 grouped-query attention，分組查詢注意力，GQA。

cues.en: So the idea is that in a typical multi-head attention mechanism, there are multiple slices of the queries,
cues.zh: 一般多頭注意力，有多個 query、

cues.en: keys, and values that all process the tokens independently of each other, and then their information
cues.zh: key、value 切片，各自處理詞元，再把資訊

cues.en: is combined by the linear mixing matrix w0.
cues.zh: 透過 W_O 線性混合矩陣結合。

cues.en: However, it's also possible for the keys and values matrices to share multiple queries vectors.
cues.zh: 但也可以讓 key 與 value 矩陣，共用多個 query 向量。
